_comment: Classes listed under headless run on the ordinary self-hosted Mac runner; every other class, including new ones, runs on the GUI runner. A headless class's file may not use window-server APIs and must build every Dock/entry factory with createsNativePanels: false (checked by native_test_partition.py check).
